title: warrant request
description: Present lane: a self-grant (grantee is the signing identity; requester channel is the trusted page origin). Filed: an agent's device-key-signed request naming itself as grantee (protocol §7.5 just-in-time flow).

message.description: Requester's rationale; shown quoted and marked unverified.

grantee.description: Filed only: the agent identity. Absent on the present lane (self-grant).

holder.description: Filed only: the holder id the grant binds to.

grantor.description: Filed only: '*' (approver chooses), 'self', or an identity; never silently substituted.

return_url.description: Filed only; echoed by respond on approve and deny.

$comment: Artefact: { warrants: [JWS…] (one per grant, in order), config_cert }. Delivered to the page (present) or the filer's poll (filed).
